name: Wall of Thorns

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a straight wall up to 60 feet long or a ring up to 20 feet across

upcast.text: Both the Piercing and the Slashing damage rise by 1d8 per slot level above 6.

summary: A wall of thick brush: Dex save, 7d8 Piercing when it appears and 7d8 Slashing to those who push into it; half on a success.
text: The wall is up to 60 ft long, 10 ft high and 5 ft thick (or a ring up to 20 ft across), and blocks sight. Each foot moved through it costs 4 feet, and a creature saves when it first enters it on a turn or ends a turn there.
